properties.name: app.http-clients.base-urls.products
properties.description: Base URL of the Products microservice, used by ProductServiceClient for HTTP Interface consumption. Overridden at runtime by the PRODUCTS_BASE_URL environment variable.

properties.name: app.http-clients.base-urls.clients
properties.description: Base URL of the Clients microservice, used by ClientServiceClient for HTTP Interface consumption. Overridden at runtime by the CLIENTS_BASE_URL environment variable.

properties.name: app.http-clients.connect-timeout
properties.description: Timeout for establishing a connection to downstream services (products, clients).

properties.name: app.http-clients.read-timeout
properties.description: Timeout for waiting for a response from downstream services (products, clients).
